dialogues.speaker: Cellar Guard Raven
dialogues.text: Halt! This is a restricted area. I cannot simply let you through...

choices.text: There's a raven sleeping in the elevator...

response.speaker: Cellar Guard Raven
response.text: Sleeping in the elevator? That cannot be true! I saw nothing of the sort...

choices.text: I've come to check the elevator...

response.speaker: Cellar Guard Raven
response.text: Ah, that... Alright then. Check it and leave as soon as possible.
